statement: Quicksort runs in O(n log n) time on every input; in particular an already-sorted array is a cheap case since it requires no swaps.
definitions: Quicksort means the deterministic textbook version that always takes the first element of the current subarray as pivot with Lomuto partition (no randomization, no median-of-three); running time is measured by the number of key comparisons; a counterexample is an explicit infinite family of inputs (one for each n) on which the comparison count is not O(n log n).
